what_happened.line: Without a quorum, the Municipal Building Design Committee took no votes and discussed the town administration building project as fact-only.

The chair reported the Board of Selectmen asked the committee to keep exploring an admin-building project after a combined renovation and addition plan was voted down at town meeting and town vote as too costly.
A member asked the committee to get the town's current long-term debt capacity, and to compare a prior design's cost against what a funded project could actually afford, before rescoping.
The committee agreed to tour town hall to see working conditions directly rather than through a third party, and to reconvene once a quorum can be assembled, tentatively September 15.

why_it_matters: This is the early rescoping of a town administration building project that residents already rejected once at town meeting and at the ballot; any new version will eventually come back to both.

The committee is asking for the town's debt capacity before setting a design, which will shape how big a project, and how large a debt exclusion or override request, could plausibly be brought to voters.
No formal committee action can happen until a quorum is seated, so membership and scheduling are still unresolved.
